{{HiRez re-made note|kind=2pg}}
High-resolution (600 dpi) image, re-coloured from a white to a black border by strangewayes, of the printed Decipher card [[Run Luke, Run!]] (Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game, Light Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Premium/Premiere Intro 2 Player/Run Luke Run.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B8qrn2aDKgPeM3AwdVhMSTdUaFU/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Run Luke Run.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,343,616 bytes, SHA-256 <code>ad71eca0f17cee691e5c97875ee2b0c2c504b1b206e6d79809c157e90b313b91</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 45.5, 47.5, 74.0, 56.5 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:P2P-L-runlukerun-decipher-archive.gif]].

Credit: scan by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
